title: Dynamical System Characterization of Heterogeneous Walker Satellite Networks: An Orbit-Aware Stochastic Geometry Perspective
summary: Heterogeneous and in particular multi-altitude low Earth orbit (LEO) satellite constellations exhibit complex spatial and temporal structures, which require new modeling tools for their performance analysis. In this paper, we develop an orbit-aware stochastic geometry framework modeling today's LEO satellites on various orbits and various altitudes. In particular, we characterize such a system as the superposition of multiple Walker point processes and formulate it as a dynamical system determined by an initial condition and the rotation speeds of satellites and Earth.
